work.title: Enforce base-integrity invariants
work.description: Convert the characterization scenarios from INIT-5 into target invariant tests. Required invariant: baseAfter minus baseBefore is one commit when accepted, and zero commits for every other operation or outcome.
acceptance: Work creation does not move the base
Plan, Review, Build, Verify, and Ship start or completion do not move the base
Refresh does not move the base
Worktree creation or recreation does not move the base
Rollback, cancel, and supersede create zero commits
The full repository test suite passes on macOS and Linux
